type: Send a welcome email to test@company.com and create a JIRA onboarding task

plan.stepDescription: Use send_email with to='test@company.com', subject='Welcome to the Company!', body='Dear Test, Welcome to the team!'.

Use create_jira_task with project='Onboarding', summary='Complete onboarding for test@company.com', description='Create and complete all onboarding steps for the new employee with email test@company.com'.
